title: Standard HeLa cell cryopreservation with DMSO
summary: 10% DMSO in FBS freezing medium, Mr. Frosty -1C/min ramp to -80C, transfer to LN2 after 24h.

title: Post-thaw viability assessment using trypan blue exclusion
summary: Rapid thaw at 37C water bath, dilute 1:10 in warm medium, count with hemocytometer, exclude trypan-blue-positive cells.

title: Trehalose cryoprotection of mammalian cells without DMSO
summary: Stepwise trehalose loading into cells via endocytosis, replace DMSO, achieve equivalent post-thaw recovery.

title: HeLa cell culture maintenance and passaging
summary: DMEM + 10% FBS, 37C 5% CO2, passage at 80-90% confluency with 0.25% trypsin-EDTA.

title: CellTiter-Glo ATP bioluminescence viability assay
summary: Lyse cells in 96-well plate, add CellTiter-Glo reagent 1:1, incubate 10 min, read luminescence.

title: Flow cytometry cell viability with LIVE/DEAD stain
summary: Stain cells with LIVE/DEAD Aqua in PBS (no serum), incubate 30 min on ice, fix or analyze directly.

title: FITC-dextran intestinal permeability assay in mice
summary: Oral gavage of 4kDa FITC-dextran (600 mg/kg), 4h transit, tail vein blood collection, fluorescence quantitation in serum.
keyParameters: Serum dilute 1:10 in PBS, read 485/528 nm

title: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG gavage in C57BL/6 mice
summary: Culture LGG in MRS broth 24h, pellet, resuspend in PBS to 1e10 CFU/mL, gavage 200 uL daily.
keyParameters: Confirm CFU by plating before each dosing week

title: Intestinal tight junction protein analysis by Western blot
summary: Isolate intestinal mucosa, homogenize in RIPA, run NuPAGE 4-12% gel, transfer to nitrocellulose, probe claudin-1 and occludin.

title: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of gut microbiome
summary: DNA extraction from stool with ZymoBIOMICS kit, V3-V4 region amplification, Illumina library prep, 2x250 paired-end sequencing.

title: Quantitative RT-PCR for tight junction gene expression
summary: Extract RNA from intestinal tissue with RNeasy, synthesize cDNA with iScript, run SYBR Green qPCR, normalize to GAPDH.
keyParameters: 1 ug RNA input per cDNA reaction
MIQE-compliant: include NTC and genomic DNA controls

title: Intestinal histology and H&E staining
summary: Swiss-roll intestinal segment fixation in 10% formalin, paraffin embedding, 5 um sectioning, H&E staining for villus/crypt morphology.
keyParameters: Score villus height and crypt depth
Blinded scoring by two independent observers

title: Mouse cytokine ELISA (IL-6, TNF-alpha)
summary: Sandwich ELISA for murine IL-6 and TNF-alpha in serum and intestinal tissue homogenate.
keyParameters: Coat plate with capture antibody 100 uL/well
Sample and standard dilutions in duplicate
Read at 450 nm, subtract 570 nm reference

title: Antibody immobilization on screen-printed carbon electrode via EDC/NHS
summary: Activate COOH-SPE with EDC/NHS, drop-cast anti-CRP antibody, block with BSA, characterize by EIS and CV.
keyParameters: 0.1 M MES pH 5.5 for EDC activation

title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy characterization of biosensors
summary: EIS measurement in 5mM Fe(CN)6 3-/4- PBS electrolyte, frequency sweep 0.1 Hz to 100 kHz, fit Randles circuit.
keyParameters: 5 mM K3Fe(CN)6 + 5 mM K4Fe(CN)6 in 0.1 M PBS
Fit Randles circuit: Rs, Rct, Cdl, Zw

title: Paper-based electrochemical biosensor fabrication for point-of-care
summary: Wax printing to define channels on Whatman 4 paper, screen-print carbon ink electrodes, functionalize with recognition element.
keyParameters: Wax printer 180C for paper channel definition
Channel width 5 mm for 10 uL sample

title: CRP quantification in whole blood by high-sensitivity ELISA
summary: Dilute whole blood 1:100 in sample diluent, run high-sensitivity sandwich ELISA, read at 450 nm.
keyParameters: Clinical cutoff: <1 mg/L normal, >10 mg/L acute inflammation

title: Differential pulse voltammetry for biosensor signal readout
summary: DPV scan from -0.2 to +0.6 V vs Ag/AgCl, peak current at +0.22 V corresponds to Fe(II) oxidation.
keyParameters: Peak current at +0.22 V vs Ag/AgCl

title: Sporomusa ovata bioelectrochemical CO2 reduction setup
summary: Inoculate H-cell with S. ovata on carbon cloth cathode at -400 mV vs SHE under continuous CO2 sparging, monitor acetate by HPLC.
keyParameters: DSMZ 311 medium modified with 50 mM NaHCO3

title: Acetate quantification by Megazyme enzymatic assay
summary: Enzymatic colorimetric assay: acetate + CoA + ATP converted to acetyl-CoA, NADH generation measured at 340 nm.
keyParameters: Centrifuge sample 10,000g 5 min to remove cells

title: Anaerobic chamber technique for strict anaerobes
summary: Prepare and handle all Sporomusa cultures in Coy anaerobic chamber (5% H2, 10% CO2, 85% N2). Pre-reduce medium with cysteine-HCl.
keyParameters: Monitor with resazurin or indigo carmine indicator

title: HPLC analysis of short-chain fatty acids including acetate
summary: Aminex HPX-87H column, 5 mM H2SO4 mobile phase, 0.6 mL/min, 35C, RI detector or UV 210 nm for organic acids.

title: Chronoamperometry for long-term bioelectrochemical monitoring
summary: Apply constant -400 mV vs SHE, record current vs time over 7-14 days, correlate cathodic current with acetate production rate.
keyParameters: Calculate Coulombic efficiency from integrated charge vs acetate mol

title: SDS-PAGE protein gel electrophoresis
summary: Denature protein samples with LDS loading buffer at 70C, load 20-30 ug/lane on NuPAGE 4-12% Bis-Tris gel, run in MOPS buffer 200V 50 min.

title: Bradford protein quantification assay
summary: Add Bradford reagent to sample, incubate 5 min, read A595. BSA standard curve 0-1500 ug/mL.

title: Immunofluorescence staining of tight junction proteins
summary: Cryosection or paraffin section of intestine, antigen retrieval (citrate pH 6), block with donkey serum, probe claudin-1 and occludin, secondary Alexa Fluor, DAPI counterstain, mount in ProLong Gold.
keyParameters: Antigen retrieval: 10 mM citrate pH 6, 95C 20 min

title: RNA extraction from mouse intestinal tissue
summary: Snap-freeze 20-30 mg intestinal tissue in liquid nitrogen, homogenize in RLT + 1% beta-ME, column purify with DNase I on-column digestion, elute in 30 uL RNase-free water.

title: ELISA general sandwich protocol
summary: Coat plate overnight, block, incubate sample + standards, biotinylated detection antibody, streptavidin-HRP, TMB substrate, stop with H2SO4, read 450-570 nm.
keyParameters: Coat overnight 4C in carbonate buffer pH 9.6

title: Statistical analysis for pre-clinical in vivo studies
summary: Power calculation prior to study, confirm normality (Shapiro-Wilk), two-tailed Student's t-test or Mann-Whitney for two groups, ANOVA + Tukey for multiple groups.
keyParameters: Report mean +/- SEM, not SD for group data

title: Cyclic voltammetry electrode characterization
summary: CV scan -0.3 to +0.7 V vs Ag/AgCl at 10-100 mV/s in 5 mM ferri/ferrocyanide PBS, determine heterogeneous rate constant and EASA.
